title: THE HOSTILES CLOSING IN LINE STANDS ON A PLATE
why: Critic on screen 37: the red hostiles closing in line under the extract countdown had no plate and sat loose on the floor. It now has the same flat HUD plate as the countdown.
now: While extraction is inbound the hostiles closing in line has a flat dark plate behind it.
